result.summary: Reorganizes functional test coverage for PSBT unknown fields in `rpc_psbt.py`. It extracts the `walletprocesspsbt` pass-through test into a dedicated method, moves implicit-versus-explicit v0 merge checks into `test_combinepsbt_preserves_unknown_fields`, and removes redundant merge assertions.
result.problem: PSBT unknown-field merge tests were duplicated across disparate test sections, and the pass-through test block included merge assertions. Mutation testing on `PSBTInput::Merge` triggered failures under the pass-through test block rather than the dedicated merge test.
evidence: Author mutation testing in description: removing `PSBTInput::Merge` unknown field insertion caused the test labeled 'Test that unknown values are just passed through' to fail instead of the dedicated combine test
result.card: Deduplicates and reorganizes PSBT unknown-field test coverage in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py. Redundant test logic in run_test caused mutations in PSBTInput::Merge to fail under a pass-through test label rather than the dedicated merge test. The change isolates pass-through assertions into their own method and consolidates version-merging assertions into test_combinepsbt_preserves_unknown_fields.

risk.why: Only reorganizes test assertions within a functional test script.
